For my job I test and write software. I use some very specific tools, so setting up my machine took me a while. But for the last 2 years my setup was perfect and it was just the way I liked it.

This morning I got the windows 10 update popup. Because a part of my job involves testing I need to upgrade sooner or later because our end users will start using the new edge browser.

So this morning I choose to download the new windows, but before the actual install I wanted to make a backup etc.

About 30 minutes pass, I'm working on some stuff, typing things. All of a sudden a popup goes to the front of the screen asking me to start the upgrade. This happens at the same moment I finish the line I'm typing and press enter.

Within a few seconds all my applications close and the upgrade starts. I had not made my backup. Fuck

After a while the setup is at 30% my pc reboots, the windows logo shows up, the screens go black. Nothing

I wait for 30 minutes, nothing.

I reboot press F8, bring me safe mode, nothing.

I go to a second computer download a Windows 10 iso, burn it and us it to boot. I have multiple recover options, none of them work, they all end with the black screen.

There is no rollback option

I decide fuck it, I'll boot in Linux. But because windows is not properly closed I can't mount my disks. U don't have a extra disk.

In the end I just formatted the entire thing and installed Linux (ubuntu mate), from now on I will only run Windows in a virtual machine.

I'm just really happy I check in all my code regularly.

TLDR accidently started the windows 10 update, fucked up my pc, installed Linux

When in doubt, buy a backup Windows installation disk for your desired OS.

I did that, I do not regret that decision after my PC decided to disagree with Windows 10.
